description: Live mini-tier: pilot YOLOv1 work; chunk fingerprints omitted so re-ingest/portable runs stay honest (min_hit_count gate only).
answer_reference_text: YOLOv1 uses a single convolutional network on the full image: (1) resize the input image to 448×448; (2) run a CNN to produce a grid of predictions (bounding boxes and class probabilities per cell); (3) threshold / non-max suppression to form final detections from the grid.
